how: Group snowboard lessons and sessions run on the dry slope at The Oakwood (formerly Sandown Ski) in Esher; The Snow Centre in Hemel Hempstead offers real-snow lessons about 40 km out.
Ski school with group lessons, private coaching and recreational sessions on a dry slope at The Oakwood in Esher; real-snow indoor slope at The Snow Centre, Hemel Hempstead (about 40 km).

Imperial College Drone Society runs an FPV racing team in London; the Grey Arrows Drone Club is a London flying association for racing quads and FPV, and London has hosted pro races at Wembley and Alexandra Palace.

Recreational drone flying is organised through London flying clubs such as the Grey Arrows Drone Club (public liability insurance for members) and the Imperial College Drone Society; UK flyer registration rules apply.
Guitar lessons for all ages and levels (acoustic, electric, classical, bass) are taught at London Guitar Academy in Hampstead and at London School of Music.
Piano lessons are offered by London School of Music alongside guitar, singing and drums, in person or online.
Guildhall School of Music & Drama has a dedicated harp department (conservatoire level); casual teachers are listed privately.
Walthamstow Wetlands (Thames Water fishery) sells day tickets for coarse and trout fishing on its reservoirs; an Environment Agency rod licence is needed.
The Angling Academy tuition pond at Walthamstow Wetlands runs family-friendly paid fishing sessions; the wider fishery sells day tickets for stocked rainbow trout.
Oyster Diving in Soho runs PADI Discover Scuba and Open Water courses with pool sessions at Marshall Street Leisure Centre; open-water dives are done at inland sites outside London.
Lee Valley Camping and Caravan Park in Edmonton is a tent and caravan site inside the London boundary; Abbey Wood and Crystal Palace also have camping and caravan sites.
Friends of Richmond Park run a free two-hour guided walk, and The Royal Parks and the Mayor of London publish self-guided nature trails.
venue: Friends of Richmond Park guided walk

how: Hampstead Heath, Richmond Park and Bushy Park have off-road running routes listed by Great Runs, with parkrun events weekly.
City Lit runs flamenco courses in its Covent Garden dance studios in daytime, evening and weekend slots; Ritmo Flamenco teaches in Greenwich.
Corrientes Social Club in Greenwich teaches Argentine tango classes, and Tango South London runs Monday and Tuesday night classes.
City Lit's Keeley Street printmaking studio has two intaglio roll presses and runs beginner to advanced etching, drypoint and aquatint courses.
City Lit runs stone and photo lithography workshops, including a three-day photo lithography course, in its Keeley Street studio.
Private bagpipe tutors in London (including Earl's Court) are listed on Airtasker; no specific band or school was confirmed.
A two-hour introductory blacksmithing course runs at the forge on Stepney City Farm (ages 16+), with longer knife-forging days also offered.
Beginner leather workshops (hand-stitched wallet or accessory) run in London through CraftCourses and ClassBento, with materials and tools provided.
Earl of East runs beginner candle-making workshops (about 90 minutes, soy candle to take home) at its Hackney base and King's Cross store.
The Japan Foundation London teaches Japanese at beginner and intermediate levels in term-time courses.
Instituto Cervantes London offers in-person and online Spanish courses for adults, teens and children at Devereux Court near Temple.
RPG Taverns near London Bridge sells tickets for guided D&D sessions most days with dice and minis provided; board game cafes also host RPG nights.
Bad Moon Cafe (London Bridge and Waterloo) and Rogues Quarter (Kentish Town) host Magic: The Gathering and other card game events and trade.

activity: Magic: The Gathering and trading card games
how: Bad Moon Cafe runs regular tournaments for Magic: The Gathering, Flesh and Blood and Warmachine; Rogues Quarter in Kentish Town hosts Magic events through the year.
Bad Moon Cafe has bespoke Warhammer tables, and BMC in Borough hosts weekly gaming nights with the London Wargaming Guild.

activity: Artisan bread and pastry baking courses
how: Bread Ahead Baking School teaches half-day to three-day bread, pastry and doughnut courses at Borough Market and Wembley.
Bean-to-bar chocolate workshops (about 2 hours) run in Notting Hill via ClassBento; chocolatiers such as Hotel Chocolat and Melt also offer classes.
Two-hour mixologist-led cocktail-making classes and immersive cocktail experiences run across London, listed on Experience Days.

activity: Hands-on cooking classes (pasta and other cuisines)
how: Hands-on cooking classes run at cookery schools such as The Avenue Cookery and via ClassBento and Experience Days.
A four-hour home barista workshop is held at an historic London roastery with a roastery tour; hands-on roasting itself was not confirmed.
venue: Home barista workshop at a London roastery (ClassBento)

how: Kaffeine runs evening latte art classes (about two hours, since 2010) at its Eastcastle Street cafe; Kiss the Hippo and ClassBento also run latte art workshops.
London Beer Lab in Brixton runs small-group workshops where participants brew about 20 litres of all-grain beer and return to bottle it.
The Hiver Experience in Kennington offers a hive inspection and honey beer tasting, and Hen Corner in west London runs an introduction to beekeeping course.
Pub quiz nights run weekly across London pubs, for example The Pub Quiz at The Old Queens Head and quiz nights at Brixton Jamm.
Hammer & Tongue runs year-round slam nights with an open slam at each, mostly at The Book Club in Shoreditch; Bang Said The Gun and Out Spoken also run spoken word nights.
venue: Hammer & Tongue at The Book Club

how: London community coding meetups such as a beginner-to-expert Code & Chat group are listed in social groups; no specific organiser page was opened.
London Guided Walks runs more than thirty themed history walks (Roman London, Pepys, Hampstead) for a flat per-person fee.
The Mayor of London publishes free self-guided heritage walks and trails under London Unseen, and Historic England has self-guided tours of London.

Welsh Harp Sailing Club on the Brent Reservoir offers windsurfing with free novice training for members on Thursday evenings; Docklands Sailing and Watersports Centre also runs beginner windsurfing courses.
Skuna Boats runs a wood-fired sauna boat at West India Quay in Canary Wharf with shared drop-in sessions and a cold plunge.
City Lit runs life drawing and portraiture courses, and London Life Drawing and London Bridge Life Drawing hold drop-in sessions in community venues.
Southbank Centre hosts monthly three-hour Out-Spoken poetry masterclasses led by leading poets; City Lit and Faber Academy also teach writing.
Half-day and two-hour perfume-making classes run in London, including Experimental Perfume Club in Covent Garden and The London Refinery in Notting Hill.
